Name: Smaller Trout Derby Fish Plaque
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Look, I just hate this fish plaque.

It's enormous, bigger than an adult pig! The plaque color's kinda weird! It's not even the RAINBOW trout you're catching for the Trout Derby! Now, I kinda forgot this until I started working on an apartment for a NPC and wanted a fish trophy. And was reminded it'd take up half his wall.

So I have produced a plaque with driftwood on it and a rainbow trout mounted on it. I've seen a hundred fish mounted like that. In fact, my dad has one.

Because of how the rewards for the Trout Derby work, I cannot add it to the reward pool, [s]so it fully replaces the original.[/s] And it has settings for recolor compatibility with Earthy, Vibrant, and Starblue that match the dark brown wood the recolors use.

Replacing the original works on a new game but not a game in progress. I left the old version that replaces it available, but the new version has you trade in the giant plaque to Willy for the smaller one. This way, you can use it on a game where you already have the plaque.

Downloads.Description: Fixes Vortex install problems, fixed manifest. Reuploaded because Nexus wasn't updating the file.
